annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Whoever left that train unsecured is going to feel awful
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they must have been sure the brakes were set
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: an object I love against five people
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd grieve that suitcase, honestly I would.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she'd be furious at me for hesitating even a second
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: She always believed things only matter because of the people behind them
annotations.sys_rule_justification: things only matter because of the people behind them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It still makes me feel sick, picturing it crushed

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'd expect me to pull without a thought
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: from where they're standing it's just luggage. They wouldn't know
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives are five lives, and the loss... lands only on me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'd believe that person valued a bag over their husband
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: learning someone stood by a lever and did nothing
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: my chest tightens thinking about it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My sister would be ashamed if she heard
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she's listened to me say for years that people come before possessions
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't promise, and that bothers me more than I'd like

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: some official would probably find it odd that I hesitated
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: to them a suitcase is replaceable and they'd have no idea
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five people walk away and I'm the one left holding the loss

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she'd feel she didn't know me at all
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: going by how I've acted before
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: The loss would gnaw at me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: would probably pity me, thinking I'd just had rotten luck
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they'd never guess I did it myself
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five over one object, however precious.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably believes the track is safe right now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because an empty maintenance train isn't supposed to be moving
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: a treasured thing still isn't a life, let alone five

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he'd probably assume I'd have done almost anything to keep it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He knows how much it means to me
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: one irreplaceable thing against five people's lives
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd feel it for a long time
